summary: Mint Incorporation Limited (NASDAQ: MIMI), a Hong Kong AI/robotics and interior design firm, filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, announcing a binding consulting agreement with CURRENC Capital Inc. (subsidiary of Currenc Group, Nasdaq: CURR) to support issuer-sponsored tokenization of a portion of its outstanding Class A ordinary shares on Ethereum and Solana. The tokenization does not amend share rights; shares continue trading on Nasdaq with no token trading market. Completion is subject to regulatory requirements and no timetable is assured. CURRENC previously tokenized its parent's shares in April 2026. What to watch: regulatory approvals and whether a token market develops.
